product_brief: An optional plugin providing out-of-the-box support for encryption to hybrid post-quantum recipients for older age clients.
pqc_capability_description: Provides support for hybrid post-quantum recipients based on HPKE with a hybrid ML-KEM-768 KEM. Recipients start with age1pq1... and identities with AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-1...
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM-768, HPKE, Ed25519 (implied by hybrid recipient type "mlkem768x25519")
latest_version: v1.3.1 (for age core; plugin version not explicitly stated, but context implies compatibility with v1.3.0+ features)
pqc_roadmap_details: Native PQC support added in age v1.3.0; plugin available for older clients.
testing_&_validation_methods: C2SP has the specification, and CCTV has test vectors for the new hybrid recipient types.
